entities.name: Absolute Direction
entities.description: You always know which way is north and can retrace any path you have followed in the last month. +3 to Navigation.

entities.name: Acute Hearing
entities.description: +1 per level to Sense rolls for hearing.

entities.name: Acute Taste and Smell
entities.description: +1 per level to Sense rolls for taste and smell.

entities.name: Acute Touch
entities.description: +1 per level to Sense rolls for touch.

entities.name: Acute Vision
entities.description: +1 per level to Sense rolls for sight.

entities.name: Ambidexterity
entities.description: You use both hands equally well and suffer no penalty for using your off hand.

entities.name: Animal Empathy
entities.description: You understand animals' motives and can tell when an animal is friendly or hostile. You never kill an animal without good reason.

entities.name: Attractive
entities.description: Appearance. +1 to reactions from people who can see you.

entities.name: Handsome
entities.description: Appearance (also called Beautiful). +4 to reactions from those attracted to your sex, +2 from everyone else.

entities.name: Very Handsome
entities.description: Appearance (also called Very Beautiful). +6 to reactions from those attracted to your sex, +2 from everyone else.

entities.name: Charisma
entities.description: +1 per level to reaction rolls from intelligent beings you actively interact with, and to Influence skills.

entities.name: Clerical Investment
entities.description: You are an ordained priest of a recognized religion, with the rights and duties that go with it. +1 to reactions from followers of your faith.

entities.name: Combat Reflexes
entities.description: Extraordinary reactions in a fight. +1 to all active defenses, +2 to Fright Checks, +6 to recover from surprise, never freeze.

entities.name: Common Sense
entities.description: The GM warns you (IQ roll) when you are about to do something foolish.

entities.name: Danger Sense
entities.description: The GM rolls against your Perception in secret when you face an ambush or hidden danger. On a success you get a warning.

entities.name: Daredevil
entities.description: Fortune favors you when you take needless risks: +1 to all skill rolls while doing so, and you may reroll critical failures.

entities.name: Empathy
entities.description: You can sense what people are feeling. On an IQ roll you can tell a person's true intentions and whether they are lying.

entities.name: Fit
entities.description: +1 to HT rolls to stay conscious, avoid death, resist disease and the like. You recover Fatigue Points twice as fast.

entities.name: Very Fit
entities.description: +2 to HT rolls to stay conscious, avoid death, resist disease and the like. You lose Fatigue Points at half the normal rate and recover them twice as fast.

entities.name: Hard to Kill
entities.description: +1 per level to HT rolls made to avoid death.

entities.name: High Pain Threshold
entities.description: You never suffer shock penalties when injured, and get +3 to HT rolls to avoid being knocked down or stunned.

entities.name: Language
entities.description: Speaking and writing a language other than your native one. Per medium (spoken or written): Broken 2, Accented 4, Native 6 points.

entities.name: Luck
entities.description: Once per hour of play you may reroll a single roll twice and take the best of the three.

entities.name: Extraordinary Luck
entities.description: As Luck, but usable once every 30 minutes of play.

entities.name: Ridiculous Luck
entities.description: As Luck, but usable once every 10 minutes of play.

entities.name: Magery
entities.description: You can sense and use magic. Magery 0 costs 5 points. Each further level costs 10 points and adds +1 to IQ when learning spells.

entities.name: Night Vision
entities.description: Each level offsets 1 point of darkness penalty, up to -9.

entities.name: Rapid Healing
entities.description: +5 to HT rolls to recover lost Hit Points and to recover from crippling injuries. Requires HT 10+.

entities.name: Status
entities.description: Your rank in society. Each level gives a +1 reaction bonus from those who recognize it.

entities.name: Comfortable
entities.description: Wealth. Starting money is twice the campaign average.

entities.name: Wealthy
entities.description: Wealth. Starting money is five times the campaign average.

entities.name: Very Wealthy
entities.description: Wealth. Starting money is twenty times the campaign average.

entities.name: Filthy Rich
entities.description: Wealth. Starting money is a hundred times the campaign average.

entities.name: Voice
entities.description: A clear, resonant, attractive voice. +2 to Diplomacy, Fast-Talk, Performance, Public Speaking, Sex Appeal and Singing, and to reactions from those who hear you.

entities.name: Bad Sight
entities.description: Nearsighted or farsighted. -6 to Vision rolls and penalties to tasks at the wrong range. Correctable with glasses at TL5+ (-10 points instead).

entities.name: Bad Temper
entities.description: You lose your temper in stressful situations and may say or do things you regret.

entities.name: Berserk
entities.description: When badly hurt or provoked you may go berserk, attacking without regard for your own safety.

entities.name: Bloodlust
entities.description: You want your foes dead and finish off fallen enemies unless you resist.

entities.name: Code of Honor
entities.description: You follow a code of conduct even when it is risky. -5 to -15 points depending on how strict it is.

entities.name: Cowardice
entities.description: You are very careful about your physical well-being and must resist to put yourself in danger.

entities.name: Curious
entities.description: You cannot resist investigating anything interesting, even when it is unwise.

entities.name: Delusions
entities.description: You believe something that is not true. -5 (minor), -10 (major) or -15 (severe).

entities.name: Duty
entities.description: You are obliged to follow orders from an employer, leader or organization. Cost depends on how often duty calls: -2 to -15.

entities.name: Enemies
entities.description: Someone wants to harm you. Cost depends on the enemy's power and how often they appear.

entities.name: Fanaticism
entities.description: You believe so strongly in a cause, country or religion that it rules your life.

entities.name: Greed
entities.description: You lust for wealth and must resist any temptation that promises a payoff.

entities.name: Gullibility
entities.description: You believe almost anything you are told. -3 to Merchant and to resisting Fast-Talk.

entities.name: Hard of Hearing
entities.description: -4 to Hearing rolls and to understanding speech.

entities.name: Honesty
entities.description: You obey the law and expect others to do the same.

entities.name: Impulsiveness
entities.description: You act first and think later.

entities.name: Intolerance
entities.description: You dislike people different from you. -5 for one group, -10 for everyone unlike you.

entities.name: Jealousy
entities.description: You react badly to anyone who seems smarter, more attractive or better off than you.

entities.name: Lecherousness
entities.description: You have an unusually strong desire for romance.

entities.name: Low Pain Threshold
entities.description: Double shock penalties, -4 to resist pain and torture.

entities.name: Miserliness
entities.description: You are reluctant to part with money and haggle over every cent.

entities.name: Obsession
entities.description: You pursue a single goal above all else. -5 for a short-term goal, -10 for a long-term one.

entities.name: Odious Personal Habit
entities.description: A habit that annoys others. -5, -10 or -15 for -1, -2 or -3 to reactions.

entities.name: One Eye
entities.description: -3 to ranged attacks and -1 to melee attacks beyond reach 1. -1 to reactions unless hidden.

entities.name: One Hand
entities.description: You cannot do things that need two hands; -4 to most tasks that normally use two.

entities.name: Overconfidence
entities.description: You believe you are more capable than you are.

entities.name: Pacifism
entities.description: You oppose violence. Reluctant Killer -5, Cannot Harm Innocents -10, Cannot Kill -15, Self-Defense Only -15, Total Nonviolence -30.

entities.name: Phobia
entities.description: An irrational fear of something. Cost depends on how common the object of fear is.

entities.name: Struggling
entities.description: Wealth. Starting money is half the campaign average.

entities.name: Poor
entities.description: Wealth. Starting money is a fifth of the campaign average.

entities.name: Dead Broke
entities.description: Wealth. You have no job, no income and nothing but the clothes on your back.

entities.name: Sense of Duty
entities.description: You feel responsible for a group and will never betray them. -2 (a friend) to -20 (all life).

entities.name: Shyness
entities.description: You are uncomfortable around strangers. Mild -5, Severe -10, Crippling -20.

entities.name: Social Stigma
entities.description: You belong to a group your society treats as inferior. -5 to -20.

entities.name: Truthfulness
entities.description: You hate to lie, and are bad at it.

entities.name: Unluckiness
entities.description: Once per session, something goes wrong for you at the worst moment, as the GM decides.

entities.name: Vow
entities.description: A sworn oath to do or not do something. -5 to -15 by how restrictive it is.

entities.name: Wounded
entities.description: An open wound that never fully heals and is easy to aggravate.

entities.name: Quirk
entities.description: A minor personal trait. You may take up to five, at -1 point each.

entities.name: Pick
entities.description: May get stuck in the target.

Stats.Notes: May get stuck in the target.

entities.name: Warhammer
entities.description: May get stuck in the target.

Stats.Notes: May get stuck in the target.

entities.name: Bastard Sword
entities.description: One-handed. Use Two-Handed Sword skill with both hands for +1 damage.

Stats.Notes: One-handed. Use Two-Handed Sword skill with both hands for +1 damage.

entities.name: Spear
entities.description: Can be thrown. Used two-handed: thr+3 imp, reach 1, 2.

Stats.Notes: Can be thrown. Used two-handed: thr+3 imp, reach 1, 2.

Stats.Damage: sw+5 cut / sw+4 imp / thr+3 imp

entities.name: Crossbow
entities.description: Two-handed. ST and damage are the bow's own ST.

Stats.Notes: Two-handed. ST and damage are the bow's own ST.

entities.name: Pump Shotgun, 12G
entities.description: Two-handed. Fires nine pellets per shot.

Stats.Notes: Two-handed. Fires nine pellets per shot.

entities.name: Ballistic Vest
entities.description: DR 5 against crushing and cutting. Concealable.

Stats.Notes: DR 5 against crushing and cutting. Concealable.

entities.name: Crowbar
entities.description: Can be used as a club.

entities.name: Grapnel
entities.description: Can be thrown up to ST x2 yards.

entities.name: Lantern
entities.description: Burns for 24 hours on a pint of oil.

entities.name: Personal Basics
entities.description: Utensils, toiletries, and the like. Without them you have -1 to Survival and similar rolls.
